viewer_sees: One lean hunter on foot stands small in the grass; beyond him a vast dark herd of bison, each animal far larger than he is
TIMELINE/SEASONS — one locked view over the Alberta basin, the light and the grass turning through seasons, small bands of hunters crossing and fading, the cliff unchanged
A runner in a wolf hide lies low in the grass, watching a calm herd; patience, not a chase
EMPTY AFTERMATH — the quiet grass slope below the cliff today, wind in the grass, nobody there
A European traveler sketches a distant hunt in his notebook; an archaeologist kneels at a dig; Blackfoot elders tell the story to the archaeologists
The camera climbs the sandstone cliff face and over the lip, revealing the wide grass basin beyond
A line of people walks across the dry basin with burning grass torches; fire creeps low and smoke drifts, fresh green shoots at the edge of the burn
An aerial glide along two converging lines of stone cairns that widen like a funnel toward the grass basin and narrow toward the cliff
Hands lay dry brush and cut sod on top of a heap of stones, making the cairn taller
MACRO OBJECT — a bison's wet nose and flaring nostrils, wind-whipped grass; the nose is the whole story
Wind ripples sweep across the grass from the herd over the whole funnel of cairns, one direction only
Dawn at the camp: sage smoke drifts over young men standing in a line, a hand sweeping the smoke
PROCESS — a young man pulls a grey wolf hide over his shoulders, another presses sage and fat into the fur
A runner in a wolf hide crawls on hands and knees through tall grass, so animal that he reads as a wolf
A runner in a calf skin throws his head back and cries like a lost calf; a cow bison lifts her head, ears forward
Two calf-skin runners crawl ahead; a line of cows follows one slow step at a time toward the mouth of the cairn lanes
Hunters crawl in single file through the grass; seen from above the line looks like a big snake, bison watching
A row of people crouches hidden behind a line of cairns, only eyes and robes above the stones
The herd has passed; people rise from behind the cairns and wave robes along the lanes, turning one straying animal back into line
CROWD-AS-TEXTURE — a dense pack of bison walks slowly in one tight mass along the lane, dust rising, a pause, then on again
Overhead: first a long thin straggling line of bison reaching the cliff edge and turning aside; then a tight pack arriving as one dark mass
The herd breaks into a run downhill along the lane, around a gentle curve that hides the cliff edge
The leaders brake at the lip, legs braced, dust surging; the pack behind pushes them on
Seen from below, a cloud of dust at the empty lip and one bison silhouette dropping against the sky
At the foot of the cliff, hunters hold spears level and keep their distance from one big bison still standing in the dust
LEDGER/ACCUMULATION — the great heap of animals below the cliff, and beside it twenty-five pickup trucks in five rows of five, drawn like a diagram
Night at the foot of the cliff: dozens of people scrape hides and cut meat by firelight, working without a pause
The camp on level ground beside the spring, then long thin strips of red meat hanging on racks in the sun and wind
PROCESS/CUTAWAY — a ten-metre cut through the earth, layer after layer of pale bone in dark soil, a small archaeologist beside it for scale
A European traveler on a rise looks down at the slope piled with bison and the busy camp, frowning, notebook in hand
The traveler at the right writes in his notebook and shakes his head; at the left a Piikani hunter looks steadily at the herd, unmoved
MACRO OBJECT — a bison’s dark eye in extreme close-up, the cliff and a tiny herd reflected in it; the animal is aware and remembers
One bison runs alone across the open plain toward another herd on the far ridge, which lifts its heads and turns to look
A bleached bison head-bone in the grass with sage stuffed into its eye sockets and nostrils; then a winter camp, people sharing dried meat by a fire
A Blackfoot elder stands on the grass at golden hour, looking up at the cliff as if saying its name
A small young figure seen from behind picks his way along the foot of the cliff toward a ledge, looking up at the lip
A shadowed ledge under the cliff, a tiny dark shape pressed against the rock; below it the pile of animals rises toward the ledge, dust falling
Hunters haul the heavy animals aside with ropes and then stop, heads bowed, looking at the shadowed ledge; one lays a hide over what they found
Blackfoot elders and an archaeologist sit on a grassy ridge; one elder points toward another cliff far off; then a close portrait of the elder, calm and level
Winter: a Piikani rider on a horse crests the ridge; below, a fur trader on a brown horse watches riders drive a herd toward the old cliffs
The herd bursts through the line of cairns and scatters back across the grass, riders wheeling after it; at the cliff one lone animal tumbles
A horse trots straight over a low cairn of the old lane, ignoring it
One mounted hunter alone gallops beside a few bison on the open plain, bow ready
EMPTY AFTERMATH — the same basin, grass bending, old cairn lines weathered, only a few lonely animals on the far ridge and then none
MACRO OBJECT — an old sepia print on a worn table showing the slope below a cliff pale with bones; the camera pushes into it
The interpretive centre built into the cliff at golden hour, visitors small on the path; Piikani elders talk at a table beside the plans
The empty cliff and basin at dusk; one rider on a fast horse gallops along the old cairn line, the old way left behind
End card: a poster of the whole story with the title and the SUBSCRIBE button at the center
